neighbours.label: an adjective marking the referent as ordinary, everyday or nearby rather than special: 'common', 'local', 'normal', 'general'
fire: Headaches are a common complaint among office workers.
We bought fresh bread from a local bakery on Sunday.
Her blood pressure returned to normal levels after rest.
The course covers general principles of accounting.
He fixed the leak with common household tools.
The story was first reported by a local newspaper.
Sleep is essential for normal brain development.
Most local farmers sell their eggs at the market.
quiet: Headaches are a rare complaint among office workers.
We bought fresh bread from a famous bakery on Sunday.
Her blood pressure climbed to dangerous levels after exercise.
The course covers advanced principles of accounting.
He fixed the leak with special plumbing tools.
The story was first reported by a national newspaper.
Sleep is essential for rapid brain development.
Most foreign farmers sell their eggs at the market.

notes: Top 32: ' common' x11, ' local' x11, plus 'general', 'normal', 'basic', 'other'. Near misses swap in an adjective that marks the referent as special, rare or distant.
